text.en:
Today you learn to say where someone is.
Estoy aquí. = I am here.
Estoy means “I am”. Aquí means “here”.
Estoy en casa. = I am at home.
En means “at” or “in”. Casa means “home”.
English uses “am”, “are”, “is”. Spanish has its own words for that.

The word for “am, are, is” changes with the person.
Estoy aquí. = I am here.
Estás aquí. = You are here.
Él está aquí. = He is here. Él means “he”.
Estamos aquí. = We are here.
Ana y Luis están aquí. = Ana and Luis are here.
Y means “and”. For several people, the word ends in -n.

Next you pick the right sentence for each picture.
First ask: who is it about? I, you, he, we, or they?
Then pick the matching word: estoy, estás, está, estamos, están.
Estamos en casa. = We are at home.
Estoy lejos. = I am far away. Lejos means “far away”.
El móvil está aquí. = The phone is here. El means “the”.
